title: The ford cutter: {name}
Cheating the lord's toll
summary: A smuggler runs carts across a ford {direction} of the toll at {settlement}, {distance} off, and robs those who will not pay him instead: {name}. Put an end to it.
offer: Every cart that goes round by the ford is the lord's coin in a thief's purse, and now he robs the ones who won't pay him. {name}, they call him. {distance} {direction} of here. Deal with him and I'll see the lord hears your name.
progress: Three carts went by the ford this morning. Three!
complete: Good riddance. The carts will come back to the bridge now, and pay like honest folk.
